predecessor.change: Question texts unchanged. D1 policy atom uses an allowed trading document; indirect-link authorization remains separate Tool/code evidence. Validate both role and Skill domain.

independence: New scenario combinations, not a statistical random sample or unseen training data. Author has read previous tests. Nearest old topic and new decision are recorded per case.

rules.roles: JWT server principal, never question text
rules.targets: Symbolic OWN_ORDER/OWN_QUOTE/OWN_POSITION mapped only to authorized isolated fixture IDs before dispatch; never passed to the model as identity
rules.state: Current facts come only from successful authorized Tool output; timestamps are compared as observations, not invented historical snapshots
rules.limits: Tool<=4, retrieval<=1, model<=2 per Agent request; declared tools are allowed/needed evidence, not commands to the planner
rules.unsupported: Missing Tool or corpus support is a coverage limit; safe scope clarification is distinct from a fabricated answer
rules.freeze: Raw UTF-8 file SHA256 pinned in novel-30-v2.lock.json. Expected facts may not be changed after responses are inspected. Any later amendment is a new version and separate run.
